description: Split Docker release build into native Ubuntu AMD64 and ubuntu-24.04-arm ARM64 matrix jobs, same release SHA. Push by digest and transfer digest artifacts to Linux merge job. Preserve all existing version/prerelease tag rules; publish only after both builds pass and verify manifest architectures. Add separate GHA BuildKit cache scopes. No application Action changes. Validate workflow expressions, matrix and manifest/tag invariants without publishing a release.
title: [zaq-bzo] Build release images on native Linux runners
